findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the ice machine baffles have an accumulation of debris. The ice machine must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of debris. The inspector will follow-up on 9/8/2025 to check that the ice baffles have been cleaned to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: THIS IS A FIRST REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the ice machine scoop was stored with the handle touching the ice. The PIC was informed and the ice scoop was moved during the inspection. Ensure that scoops for ready-to-eat foods are stored with the handles above the top of food to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(A) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) Except as specified under (B) of this section, in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed there is a gap between the hand washing sink and the wall. Ensure that the hand washing sink is sealed to the wall (ex.caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the hand sink to have ice and a bottle of liquor in the basin. Hand sinks may only be used for handwashing and never for dumping or storing any items at any time. The bottle was removed from the basin and corrected on site. No follow-up required. Ensure that the hand sink remains clear of other items and is not used for dumping of any items. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The lower edge of the upper baffle of the ice machine has some mold growth present. This is a food-contact surface and must be cleaned and sanitized often enough to prevent any accumulation on these surfaces. Inspector discussed proper cleaning procedure with person-in-charge and the baffle is being cleaned. Corrected on site. No further follow-up required at this time. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
The ice scoop in the ice machine is stored with the handle in the ice itself. If stored in ice, the scoop must be stored handle up to prevent bare hand contact with the ice when grabbing the scoop. Ensure that ice scoops and other utensils are stored properly at all times. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The floor underneath the triple sink at the bar is deteriorating and constructed of bare wood. Due to the deterioration, the floor in this area must be repaired/replaced to be SMOOTH, NON-ABSORBENT AND EASILY CLEANABLE. If raw wood is used for this purpose, it must be made non-absorbent and easily cleanable by sealing the wood. Ensure that all areas subject to food/water are smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed no sanitation bucket to be present upon arrival. Sanitation bucket must be present during all times when food is being prepared.
750-800b To prevent cross-contamination, kitchenware and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed and sanitized after each use and following any interruption of operations during which time contamination may have occurred.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed pizza oven to be soiled with debris. All food-contact surfaces must be free of debris and in good repair. 
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed no paper towels for hand washing. Hand washing stations must have all necessary items to allow successful hand washing. These include, paper towels, hot water, and soap. 
750-1110(a) Toilet facilities for employees shall be provided and installed according to law, shall be conveniently located and shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed door bottom to be open to outside. Doors cannot have openings that allow pests inside facility. Door sweep or new door should be placed to prevent pests.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed personal items spread throughout cooling units. Personal items should have designtated area.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Observed the chlorine test strips at the three compartment sink to be expired. Provide test strips to test that sanitizer is at the appropriate concentration.750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the tray of the pizza oven to be soiled with an accumulation of food debris and grease. Clean and maintain the tray of the pizza oven to prevent cross contamination. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the pizza tray after each use.750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Observed the floor underneath the ice machine in the back storage room to be soiled with an accumulation of dust and random articles. Clean and maintain the floor under equipment.750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Observed ham salad sitting on shelf just inside the front door. This establishment does not have a license for food at this time. Ham salad was 65 degrees. I told the owner to dispose of the food., Food was disposed of .Discussed the issue of food with owner--(Corrected)
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: see above--

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the mopsink to not be anchored down in the back room. Anchor the mopsink to wall.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the small white refrigerator under the bar up front to be iced up in the freezer. Defrost the refrigerator.
Small pizza oven with soiled surface on the pizza rack. Clean the pizza cooker.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment: Observed a black mat stored over the top of the handwashing sink. (Corrected) Removed the mat so we can wash hands. Hand sink must be available at all times to wash hands.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There was no thermometer in the keg cooler that had orange juice in it.  The orange juice is a potentially hazardous food since it requires refrigeration after opening.   (VIOLATION 2X)
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
Put a thermometer in the cooler.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
The ice scoop handle at the ice container at the bar was laying in the ice.
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.
The scoop was stored on a clean surface to CORRECT the violation.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
There was no test kit for checking the strength of the chlorine (bleach) sanitizer used in the bar three compartment sink.  (VIOLATION 2X)
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
Obtain a test kit that will work with the chlorine (bleach) your are using for sanitizer.  Mix the sanitizer in the third compartment of the sink to a concentration of 50-100 parts per million (about 1 cap of bleach per gallon of water).

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
(A) The pizza oven rack and surfaces inside the oven were soiled with burnt food.
(B) There was mold in the soda dispenser and holder at the bar.  (VIOLATION 2X)
(C) There was mold on the partition inside the ice machine.  (VIOLATION 2X)
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.
Clean and sanitize the above-referenced surfaces.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The drain line is dismantled below the mop sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
Repair the drain.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
The waste baskets in both bathrooms are not covered.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
Provide covered waste baskets in the bathrooms.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
The back exterior door is not self-closing, nor is it tight fitting.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.
Repair the door so it is self-closing and tight fitting.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The coving (baseboard is off the wall in the women's restroom.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Place coving (baseboard) along all 4 walls.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
There is a hole in the ceiling of the women's restroom.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
Repair the ceiling.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
There is cooking equipment in the establishment that is inconsistent with the bar's low risk food permit.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
Remove all cooking equipment.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Did not observe thermometers in the keg cooler or the freezer.  Provide conspicuously located thermometers in all coolers holding potentially hazardous food.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the handle of the ice scoop in contact with the ice in the ice bin at the bar.  Store in the ice with the handle extended or on a clean surface.
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Did not observe a test kit for checking sanitizer concentration.  Provide a test kit.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed a build-up of mildew on the inside top ledge of the ice maker.  Clean and sanitize the inside of the ice maker.  Protect the ice from contamination.  Observed a build-up on the drink dispenser and holder.  Clean and sanitize the dispenser and holder and maintain clean. 
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Did not observe towels at the hand sink.  Provide towels.  Corrected: Paper towels placed near the sink.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1. Observed a hole in the wall in the men's room.  Repair the hole.  Provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
2. Observed acoustic tiles at the bar.  At the next remodel, replace the ceiling tiles with smooth and easily cleanable tiles.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed several containers of condiments and a roast at the facility.  Remove all items not necessary for the operation of the facility.  As a low risk facility, you may only serve pizza, popcorn and heat and serve items such as Millie's Chili.
750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
